name: Owaru Sekai to Birthday
original_name: 終わる世界とバースデイ
source:
On September 29, 2012, the world will end. The majority of people did not believe in this internet rumour, but many were still apprehensive as the date approached. Kazuomi was not one of these people. To him, the most important thing is to protect his late best friend Touya’s younger sister Iri whose eyesight is close to blindness. She had mistaken him for her own brother since Touya’s death in a motorcycle accident two years ago. Later, his classmate Mikaeru enlisted him into her unofficial circle, the ’9.29 countermeasures group’, which investigates whether or not the rumours are true and plans ways to prevent the end of the world. September 29 is fast approaching. It is the date when Touya died, and also Iri’s birthday.

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/07/01/july-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
2012年9月29日，世界将迎来终结。大多数人并不相信这则网络传言，但随着日期逼近，仍有许多人惴惴不安。冬谷和臣不在其中。对他而言，最重要的是保护已故挚友千崎陶也的妹妹千崎入莉。入莉的视力已近乎失明；自陶也两年前因摩托车事故去世后，她便一直把和臣误认成自己的哥哥。后来，同学夏越大天使拉和臣加入她私下组织的“9·29对策组”。这个小组负责调查传言是真是假，并设法阻止世界末日。9月29日越来越近——那一天既是陶也的忌日，也是入莉的生日。

[编译自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/07/01/july-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
